solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Old puzzle by a retiring storyteller

indicators.note: retiring means drawing back, so the puzzle and the a are read backwards

parts.note: pose in an old sense is a puzzle, something that baffles, as in a poser

explanation.surface: A shy old teller of tales is set a riddle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retiring' turns POSE plus A round to give the name. 'Old' belongs to the wordplay, though it seems to qualify the storyteller.
explanation.definitionFit: Aesop was the ancient Greek fabulist famed for animal fables, a classic teller of stories.

clue.text: Elite group leaves in a minute

indicators.note: in means the leaves are placed inside the a and minute pair

parts.note: tea is made from dried leaves, so leaves gives tea

explanation.surface: A top team departs within sixty seconds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' looks like a verb meaning departs, but it is the noun: tea leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: The A-team is an idiom for the best players or staff available, a top-tier squad.

clue.text: Withdraw from bear with fluffy hair

parts.note: to bear something is to tolerate or stand it
down is the soft fine hair or feathers of a chick or face

explanation.surface: Someone retreats from a bear with a fuzzy coat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bear' looks like the animal but is the verb meaning tolerate.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand down is an idiom for resigning or withdrawing from a post or contest.

clue.text: Father runs with a very large umbrella

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
so means very, as in so good
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: Dad hurries off holding a huge brolly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'very large' looks like one description of the umbrella, but splits into SO and L.
explanation.definitionFit: A parasol is a light sunshade, a kind of umbrella carried against the sun.

clue.text: I'd return in disguise as a burglar, perhaps

indicators.note: something in disguise has its look changed, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A thief plans to come back incognito.
explanation.definitionFit: A burglar is one example of someone who enters a place unlawfully, hence the 'perhaps'.

clue.text: Deny panic needed to be represented in alien invasion movie

indicators.note: to be represented is to be presented again in another form, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A film about aliens must show people refusing to panic.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1996 blockbuster film about extraterrestrials attacking Earth bears this title.

clue.text: Time to replace Charlie as lead in musical — this is strong material

indicators.note: to replace means time takes the place of Charlie, which leads the show's title

parts.note: Cabaret is the Kander and Ebb stage musical
Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A stage show needs a new opening and some sturdy fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as lead in musical' says Charlie is the first letter of CABARET; swapping in T gives the fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Tabaret is a durable upholstery silk woven with stripes of satin, a hard-wearing fabric.

clue.text: Institution for learning about marriage

parts.note: uni is short for university, a place of higher learning
on means about, as in a book on birds

explanation.surface: A college teaches a course on wedlock.
explanation.definitionFit: A union is a joining of two people, and marriage is the classic such bond.

clue.text: Destroy AI created by mistake

indicators.note: made by mistake means formed wrongly, so the letters come out in a new order

explanation.surface: An artificial intelligence made in error must be wiped out.
explanation.definitionFit: To eradicate is to root out or wipe out entirely, a synonym for destroy.

clue.text: Went and got married again

definitions.meaning: to repair to a place is a formal way to say to go there
read as ..., it means coupled up once more

explanation.surface: Someone headed off and wed a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: Repair as a verb of motion means go, while re-paired means matched with a partner again.

clue.text: Braindead oddly screened in British Library — this relates to 6

indicators.note: in means those letters are set inside the British Library letters

parts.note: BL is the abbreviation for the British Library

indicators.note: the odd letters of the word are screened off, leaving the even ones

explanation.surface: A dim-witted person is concealed in a London library.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly screened' means the odd-numbered letters are screened off, keeping the even ones. 6 is UNION, marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Bridal is an adjective for anything concerning a bride or a wedding, so it concerns marriage.

clue.text: Way to do things as Superman did, flying with two ducks

indicators.note: flying suggests letters whizzing about into a new arrangement

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, written O, so two ducks are two Os

explanation.surface: Superman's usual method was to soar alongside a pair of waterfowl.
explanation.definitionFit: Modus operandi is Latin for method of working, a characteristic way of operating.

clue.text: Bishop and other man left New York, over part of the city

parts.note: B is the chess notation for bishop
with bishop as a chess man, the other man is a rook, another chess piece

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the New York letters run backwards

explanation.surface: A clergyman and another fellow quit Manhattan.
explanation.walkthrough: Bishop and rook are both chessmen. The city is New York, so 'part of the city' is one of its boroughs.
explanation.definitionFit: Brooklyn is one of the five boroughs making up New York City.

clue.text: Identify upcoming English singer, touring county

indicators.note: touring means going round, so these letters enclose the county
upcoming in a down clue means the letters rise, reading bottom to top

explanation.surface: Spot a rising English vocalist on a tour of the shires.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upcoming' reverses both English and singer, since in a down light the letters then read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To recognise someone is to identify them as known, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Short ball boy appearing first with drum

indicators.note: appearing first means the boy's name comes before the ball

parts.note: Tim is a boy's name

indicators.note: short means the word is cut off before its last letter

explanation.surface: A curtailed game of catch, a lad up front with a percussion instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A timbal, or timbale, is a kettledrum, a type of percussion instrument.

clue.text: Have fun and dish the dirt?

definitions.meaning: to fool around or mess about playfully
taken literally; the question mark marks the joke on the gossiping idiom

explanation.surface: Enjoy yourself and spread some gossip.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to fool around, and literally it is scattering dirt around.

clue.text: Namely, my cakes

parts.note: sc, for scilicet, is the abbreviation meaning namely
one's can stand in for my in formal speech, as in to do one's best

explanation.surface: Someone names their own baked goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Scones are small baked items, a kind of cake often served with jam and cream.

clue.text: Quiet from around the end of April/4th of June

indicators.note: around means the from letters wrap the two picked letters

parts.note: since means from, as in since Monday

indicators.note: the end of picks the last letter of the word
4th of picks the fourth letter of the word

explanation.surface: A hush falling from late April to early June.
explanation.walkthrough: The slash just separates two selections: the last letter of April and the fourth of June, L and E, sit inside SINCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Silence is the absence of noise, the same as quiet used as a noun.

clue.text: Former lover audibly kissed boy, as anticipated

parts.note: an ex is a former partner

indicators.note: audibly means the word is taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: to peck is to give a quick kiss
Ted is a boy's name

explanation.surface: An old flame gave a boy a smooch, just as everyone predicted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'audibly' applies only to the kiss: the past tense pecked sounds like the middle of the answer plus the boy's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Expected means foreseen or anticipated, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Panic if I capsize, not entirely flipped over in ocean

indicators.note: flipped over means the run of letters is read backwards, upwards in a down light
not entirely means only a part of these words is used

explanation.surface: A sailor's panic as the boat overturns at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: The run CIFICAP inside 'Panic if I capsize', read upwards, gives the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pacific is the largest of the world's oceans.

clue.text: Horseshoe perhaps found in cargo hold 14

indicators.note: found in, together with the about trailing muck in 14, says these letters are mixed up together

parts.note: the answer to 14 is muck about, and its first word muck joins the fodder

explanation.surface: A lucky horseshoe turns up in the ship's hold.
explanation.walkthrough: 14 is MUCK ABOUT: MUCK joins CARGO HOLD as fodder and ABOUT is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A horseshoe is a classic talisman thought to bring fortune, one example of such a token.

clue.text: Work in eastern state

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a musical work

explanation.surface: A job in an Eastern region of a country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'state' looks like a place, but here it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To opine is to express a view, much as to state an opinion.

clue.text: Soldier runs away in a state

indicators.note: away means the runs letter goes missing from the soldier

parts.note: a marine is a soldier serving with a navy
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A trooper deserts and is left in a panic.
explanation.definitionFit: Maine is the north-easternmost US state in New England.

clue.text: Short skirt worn by underling?

parts.note: a mini is a very short skirt
clothes that are on are being worn

explanation.surface: A lowly assistant sports a miniskirt.
explanation.definitionFit: A minion is a servile subordinate or follower, a synonym for an underling.

clue.text: Bloom to remove hat when returning, entering house in Dublin

indicators.note: entering means those letters go inside the Dublin house

parts.note: the Dail is the lower house of the Irish parliament, which sits in Dublin

indicators.note: returning means coming back, so the hat-removing word is read backwards

parts.note: to doff a hat is to take it off

explanation.surface: A man doffs his cap on coming back into a Dublin home.
explanation.walkthrough: The house is the Irish lower house of parliament, not a dwelling; 'when returning' and 'entering' act on the hat-removing word.
explanation.definitionFit: A daffodil is a yellow spring flower, a bloom of the narcissus family.

clue.text: Greek goddess not originally seen in Cyprus graveyard

indicators.note: in means the shortened goddess sits inside the Cyprus letters

parts.note: CY is the international code for Cyprus

indicators.note: not originally means the goddess loses her first letter

parts.note: Demeter is the Greek goddess of the harvest

explanation.surface: An ancient deity is unexpectedly spotted at a Cypriot burial site.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not originally' removes the goddess's first letter before she goes into the Cyprus code.
explanation.definitionFit: A cemetery is a burial ground, the same thing as a graveyard.

clue.text: Copper to restrain an attractive person

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
to tie someone up is to restrain them

explanation.surface: A police officer holds back someone good-looking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' suggests a police officer, but it is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutie is informal for someone charming or good-looking.
